policy: A linked page, report, spreadsheet or tool description is a source record, not automatically an independently sampled game cohort, authentic purchase ledger or external model validation.

families.observed_population: currently priced US Indie-tagged games first listed 2020–2022 with at least 100 reviews during year one
families.independence: one underlying selected game set; update-month measurement and long-tail analysis are separate estimates over overlapping records
families.notes: Two publisher-authored September reports reuse one selected 1,312-game roster and review histories. Article-specific post-month contributor counts remain 375 vs 311, not independently reconciled.

families.observed_population: selected currently paid positive-derived-first-week-revenue model rows; excludes unmeasurable and zero-estimated games
families.independence: one provider-derived panel and companion analysis, not two samples of authentic paid orders
families.notes: Hugging Face public panel and provider's report share the 10,403-row estimated outcome; provider methodology additionally mentions a separate 32,106-row training corpus and is not asserted to be identical.

families.observed_population: GameDiscoverCo's provider-modeled lifetime gross outcomes for the January 2026 Steam release-month cohort
families.independence: one vendor release-month model disclosed in a newsletter and linked spreadsheet, not independent validation
families.notes: Publisher directly links entire January cohort chart to its Google Sheet. The source describes vendor-model results, not merchant-reconciled bank receipts.

related_documents_not_independent_replic.notes: This article samples 4,209 low-first-year-review survivors out of a broader 12,961-currently-priced roster; it is not the same 1,312 higher-review games.
Methodology refers to 32,106 training/validation records and 6,422 held-out records, not an asserted one-to-one match with the 10,403 lever panel.
